Override of AbstractProceduralTextureNode.method3042 (getMonochromeRow per the base class CSV; DirectionalStripeTextureNode is `AbstractProceduralTextureNode(0, true)` -- 0 inputs, monochrome, a leaf procedural generator). For each column, looks up two coordinate values from the shared tables PerlinNoiseTextureNode.anIntArray6432 (indexed by column) and PerlinNoiseTextureNode.anIntArray6035 (indexed by row), scales them by anInt9099/anInt9095 respectively to get combined per-axis phase values, then classifies each pixel as inside/outside a diagonal stripe band by comparing wrapped phase differences against the anInt9098 threshold, writing either 4096 (inside stripe) or 0 (outside) into the output row. The combination of two independently-weighted axis frequencies (anInt9099 for x, anInt9095 for y) is what produces a stripe pattern at an adjustable diagonal angle, matching the class name 'DirectionalStripe'. `if (i_2_ != 255) anIntArray9096 = null` at the end is a dead decoy per the base class's mono-row tag convention (255); anIntArray9096 is an unrelated merged companion field (see below).
